video_prompt: One continuous vertical front-camera phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. A young man with fair freckled skin, short copper-ginger hair and a short ginger beard, in a plain navy-blue sweater, stands alone in a dark home office at night in front of a forest-green wall with a warm desk lamp, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. The phone is held steady at arm's length; the room behind him stays still and dim. He talks straight into the camera in a confident, conspiratorial tone, like telling a friend a secret, with small natural head movements.
